{{Quote|Special Executive Rasmus Blys, CZ-198's overseer. Backstabber, kiss-off and one of Corporate Quarterly's "Top 500 Managers to Watch."|Eva Kaayz|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Corporate Quarterly''' was a business magazine that was in circulation during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] Special Executive, [[Rasmus Blys]], was listed in the publication's "Top 500 Managers to Watch."
